sloka: सुमालिनो ऽपि भार्यासीत्पूर्णचद्रनिभानना ।नाम्ना केतुमती राम प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयसी ।। ७.५.३८ ॥
transliteration: sumālino 'pi bhāryāsītpūrṇacadranibhānanā ।nāmnā ketumatī rāma prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī ।। 7.5.38 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, Sumali also had a wife named Ketumati, whose face was like the full moon and who was dearer to him than his own life.
